item.title: LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them
item.description:
Jeves-style decision models give a clear choice from a set of options, useful for automated actions. The paper shows that many large language models (LLMs) can already do this without extra training, and offers a simple framework – LLM2Jev – to extract calibrated decisions from the model’s token probabilities. If you need reliable, action‑ready decisions from an LLM, this method lets you use the model as is or fine‑tune it with minimal effort, improving accuracy and trust in automated workflows.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud infrastructure, here is what to do: 1. Identify a decision point in your system that needs a categorical outcome (e.g., scaling decision, alert routing). 2. Use LLM2Jev to wrap a pre‑trained LLM and extract the probability distribution over your options directly from token logits. 3. If the default calibration isn’t sufficient, fine‑tune the model with a small, task‑specific dataset using LLM2Jev’s objective to improve precision. This gives you an out‑of‑the‑box, low‑maintenance decision engine for your automation pipelines.

item.title: [News] Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
item.description: Google DeepMind has announced Gemini 4 Argon, the next generation of its frontier intelligence model. This release expands the capabilities available for integration with Google’s ecosystem, including Workspace, M365 and other enterprise tools.

item.title: [News] Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
item.description: Microsoft Research has unveiled a machine‑learning system that forecasts space‑weather events, offering 30–60 minute lead time to anticipate potential damage to power grids and disruptions to GPS and satellite operations.

item.title: [News] Open TTS Leaderboard: Scalable Evaluation for Multilingual Text-to-Speech and Voice Cloning
item.description: Hugging Face released the Open TTS Leaderboard, a framework for scalable evaluation of multilingual text-to-speech and voice cloning models. The tool benchmarks various TTS systems but does not introduce new products or APIs.

item.title: [News] Turn Energy Efficiency Into Strategic Advantage
item.description: A study published by MIT Sloan examines how executives across 10 countries and multiple industries use digital technologies to improve energy efficiency and sustainability. The research involved interviews and surveys but does not involve any AI or IT infrastructure changes.

item.title: [News] Introducing SynthID Bio
item.description: Google DeepMind has unveiled SynthID Bio, a proof‑of‑concept system that embeds watermarks into AI‑generated proteins while preserving their biological function. The technology aims to provide traceability and ownership for synthetic biomolecules.
